name: Stability Ball Seated Balance

instructions.description: Sit in the center of a stability ball with feet hip width apart on the floor.
Lengthen through your spine and gently brace the trunk.
Hold the upright seated position or slowly shift weight in small circles without lifting the feet.
Step off the ball carefully when finished.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a ball size that allows hips and knees near right angles.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Raise one arm at a time to increase balance demand.

commentsNotes: Position the ball on a non-slip surface.
Stay close to a wall if you are new to the drill.
